Hyper3D Rodin generates mesh, UVs, textures, and editable 3D models you can preview, refine, optimize, and export in common 3D formats. 1 Start with Text or Image Upload a reference image, sketch, product photo, multi-view set, or enter a text prompt to start your AI 3D model generation. [图标] 2 Generate with Control Guide the model’s shape and structure with bounding boxes, voxels, or point clouds while Hyper3D Rodin generates geometry, UVs, textures, and materials. [图标] 3 Refine and Export Preview your 3D model, adjust topology and texture quality, optimize the result, and export in common 3D formats like GLB, FBX, OBJ, STL, or USDZ.
